name: agenda-pairs
title: Loop over data in pairs
summary: Today's meetings stored as one flat array of start/end hours; a loop with step 2 and until = arrayLength draws one bar per pair, labels its duration and dims the ones already over, over an hour grid drawn by a second stepped loop.
prompt: Show today's meetings (9:00–10:30, 11:00–12:00, 13:30–14:30, 15:00–16:45) as bars on an 8 to 18 h timeline with hour labels, each bar labelled with its length, a red now line at 14:00 and finished meetings dimmed.
teaches: Store records as consecutive values in one floatArrays (start, end, start, end …) and walk them with loop step 2: arrayGet(@meetings, i) and arrayGet(@meetings, i + 1)
Bound a loop by the data, not a constant: until = arrayLength(@meetings), so adding a pair adds a bar
Use a loop's from/until/step for an axis: hours 8..18 every 2 with the index itself as the label
Derive per-item state from the item: alpha 1 - 0.6 * step(@now, end) dims a meeting once it is over
pitfalls: The loop index counts array slots, not records: with step 2 the k-th record is at i = 2k, so a row position written i * 15 moves 30 px per record
until is exclusive and is compared with the index (i < until): until = arrayLength(@meetings) stops at the last pair; until 19 with from 8 step 2 still reaches 18
A loop has no break or filter: hide the items you do not want with a mask (alpha, size), or prepare the array so it only holds what to draw
Put the axis scale in one variable from componentWidth() (px) rather than a literal 31 px per hour in every expression: the timeline then fits any width

snippets.note: loop i from 0 until arrayLength(@meetings) step 2: one bar per (start, end) pair
dim when the end is before @now
hour grid: loop h from 8 until 19 step 2, index printed as the label

check.describe: Four bars on four rows: 1.5 h and 1.0 h dimmed (before 14:00), 1.0 h (13:30–14:30, crossing the red now line) and 1.75 h bright; hour labels 8 to 18; "4 meetings" top right. Resized (narrow 240, wide 540) the 8–18 h axis spans the canvas: one hour is px = (componentWidth() - 50) / 10, read by the grid, the now line and every bar, and the count stays at the right edge.
